title: AutoFyn Technical Report: Non-Parametric Expert Iteration for Long-Horizon Agents
abstract: arXiv:2609.05446v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We introduce AutoFyn, an agent harness inspired by the Expert Iteration algorithm, adapting a frozen model across many rounds by updating persistent state from verified reward signals rather than model weights. Each round begins from a fresh model session, and durable information is reintroduced only through explicit interfaces such as persistent memory files, reports, and repository state. Within a round, an orchestrator explores, plans and builds many alternative approaches with specialized agents, while a task-grounded verifier verifies the work and supplies an objective reward for measuring progress. This reward is distilled back into the persistent state, which updates the effective policy for the next round. In this technical report, we formalize this loop and describe its persistent state and verification interfaces. We then demonstrate its use in three domains, namely olympiad mathematics, data science, and cybersecurity. On the

translated_title: AutoFyn 技术报告：面向长程智能体的非参数专家迭代
translated_abstract: 我们提出 AutoFyn，一种受专家迭代算法启发的智能体框架，通过基于经验证的奖励信号更新持久状态（而非模型权重）来在多轮迭代中适配一个冻结的模型。每一轮都从全新的模型会话开始，持久信息仅通过显式接口重新引入，例如持久记忆文件、报告和代码库状态。在一轮之中，编排器与专门化的智能体协作，探索、规划并构建多种备选方案，同时一个基于具体任务的验证器对工作进行验证，并提供用于衡量进展的客观奖励。该奖励随后被蒸馏回持久状态，从而更新下一轮的有效策略。在本技术报告中，我们对这一循环进行了形式化，并描述了其持久状态与验证接口。随后，我们展示了该方法在三个领域中的应用，即奥林匹克数学、数据科学和网络安全。
tldr: AutoFyn 提出了一种非参数化的专家迭代框架，通过利用经验证的奖励信号持续更新持久状态而非模型权重，使冻结模型能够跨多轮任务有效改进，并在奥数、数据科学和网络安全三个领域得到验证。
en_tdlr: AutoFyn introduces a non-parametric expert iteration framework that adapts a frozen model across rounds by updating persistent state from verified reward signals instead of model weights, demonstrating effectiveness in olympiad mathematics, data science, and cybersecurity.
